parameters.name: APIAvailable
parameters.description: Specifies whether the SMS API is currently available on this device (the API could be disabled or could have exhausted its resources)..

parameters.name: APIUsers
parameters.description: Specifies the current number of Applications using the SMS API.

parameters.name: QueueState
parameters.description: Specifies the state of the SMS API Queue.

parameters.name: QueueNum
parameters.description: Specifies the current number of requests waiting in the SMS API Queue.

parameters.name: QueueReceived
parameters.description: Specifies the number of requests in the SMS API Queue that have been received. The counter will be reset whenever the device reboots or the {{param|#.Enable}} parameter is set to {{true}}.

parameters.name: QueueDiscarded
parameters.description: Specifies the number of requests in the SMS API Queue that have been discarded. The counter will be reset whenever the device reboots or the {{param|#.Enable}} parameter is set to {{true}}.

object.description: This object contains parameters related to the Monitoring of the SMS API.
